title: SR-AttELM-H: technique for adaptive reconstruction of asynchronously delivered sensor data
description: Code of the technique for adaptive reconstruction of asynchronously delivered sensor data using availability-aware spatiotemporal attention and a sector-structured recurrent extreme learning machine: evaluation protocol with generation and arrival times, re-implementation of the technique, adapter of the official AGG core, packet-level network delay model and a Google Colab notebook that reproduces Section 7.8 of the article.
